name: OpnForm
description: OpnForm is an open-source form builder and alternative to Typeform and Google Forms. Forms support conditional logic, file uploads, payments, custom themes and embedding, and submissions land in a dashboard or go out to email, webhooks, Slack, Discord and Google Sheets.

notes.text: Open the URL and create the admin account on the setup page; public registration closes afterwards and free self-hosted instances allow 2 users.
For a domain or reverse proxy, set APP_URL and FRONT_URL in /opt/opnform_data/api.env, then run `php artisan optimize` in /opt/opnform/api.
